sentences.en: If I ask you to think of the most famous architect in American history,
sentences.zh: 如果我让你想出美国历史上最著名的建筑师，

sentences.en: even if you don't think you know anything at all about architecture,
sentences.zh: 即使你认为自己对建筑一窍不通，

sentences.en: I bet you could take a guess.
sentences.zh: 我敢说你也能猜出一个名字。

sentences.en: And I bet your guess would be...
sentences.zh: 而且我敢说你的答案会是……

sentences.en: Frank Lloyd Wright, perhaps the greatest architect of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特，或许是20世纪最伟大的建筑师。

sentences.en: The genius with a T-square has been called the pace-setter of modern-day architecture.
sentences.zh: 这位手持丁字尺的天才，被誉为现代建筑的领路人。

sentences.en: One of the most extraordinary men of our time.
sentences.zh: 我们这个时代最非凡的人物之一。

sentences.en: He has literally established the pace for innovations and new ideas in the field of architecture.
sentences.zh: 他确实为建筑领域的创新和新理念设定了步伐。

sentences.en: Frank Lloyd Wright left a legacy of some of the most iconic and gorgeous buildings in the United States,
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特留下了美国一些最具标志性且华丽的建筑遗产，

sentences.en: like the spiraling Guggenheim Museum in New York,
sentences.zh: 比如纽约螺旋形的古根海姆博物馆，

sentences.en: the Falling Water House in Pennsylvania, which straddles a waterfall,
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州横跨瀑布之上的流水别墅，

sentences.en: and the futuristic Marin Civic Center, which is the backdrop for Gattaca, which is an awesome movie.
sentences.zh: 以及作为电影《千钧一发》（一部很棒的电影）背景的未来主义风格的马林县政务中心。

sentences.en: And that is producer Avery Truffelman.
sentences.zh: 那位是制片人艾弗里·特鲁费尔曼。

sentences.en: By the end of his career, Wright was on a level of celebrity usually reserved for actors and rock stars.
sentences.zh: 到职业生涯末期，赖特的名气达到了通常只有演员和摇滚明星才能企及的高度。

sentences.en: He was a household name, and he was on late-night talk shows.
sentences.zh: 他家喻户晓，还经常上深夜脱口秀节目。

sentences.en: Some quarters have denounced Wright as an impractical visionary and a pompous windbag.
sentences.zh: 有些圈子曾谴责赖特是一个不切实际的空想家和自命不凡的吹牛大王。

sentences.en: How do you feel about such criticism, Mr. Wright?
sentences.zh: 赖特先生，您对这样的批评有何感想？
对我没什么特别的影响。

sentences.en: So Wright wasn't just known for being a genius architect.
sentences.zh: 所以赖特不仅仅因为是天才建筑师而闻名。

sentences.en: He made headlines because he was a character.
sentences.zh: 他之所以频频登上头条，是因为他个性十足。

sentences.en: He often wore this outfit that included a flowy cape and a hat and cane.
sentences.zh: 他经常穿着一套包括飘逸斗篷、帽子和手杖的行头。

sentences.en: He wrote manifestos, launched insults at other architects,
sentences.zh: 他撰写宣言，对其他建筑师冷嘲热讽，

sentences.en: and loudly critiqued politicians, religion, and society.
sentences.zh: 还大声批评政客、宗教和社会。

sentences.en: He declared himself the greatest architect who ever lived.
sentences.zh: 他宣称自己是有史以来最伟大的建筑师。

sentences.en: You see, I chose honest arrogance and have seen no occasion to change now.
sentences.zh: 你看，我选择了诚实的傲慢，至今也没觉得有什么需要改变的。

sentences.en: And Frank Lloyd Wright had this wildly scandalous private life.
sentences.zh: 而且弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的私生活极其荒唐。

sentences.en: There were suits against him, property seized, jail, finally divorce.
sentences.zh: 他遭遇过诉讼、财产被扣押、坐牢，最后是离婚。

sentences.en: The raw material for big, spicy headlines.
sentences.zh: 这些都是劲爆头条的绝佳素材。

sentences.en: Frank Lloyd Wright was the darling of the sensational press.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特是煽情媒体的宠儿。

sentences.en: But this bombastic character ultimately changed the field of architecture
sentences.zh: 但正是这个夸夸其谈的人物，最终改变了建筑领域，

sentences.en: and introduced a new philosophy of building.
sentences.zh: 并引入了一种全新的建筑哲学。

sentences.en: Before many of Wright's iconic and famous structures were completed,
sentences.zh: 在赖特许多标志性名作完工之前，

sentences.en: before Fallen Water, before the Guggenheim, before the Marin Civic Center,
sentences.zh: 在流水别墅、古根海姆、马林县政务中心之前，

sentences.en: his most significant contribution to our everyday lives was something much more modeSt.
sentences.zh: 他对我们日常生活最重要的贡献其实要朴实得多。

sentences.en: A small, sturdy, inexpensive, and most importantly, very beautiful house
sentences.zh: 那是一座小巧、坚固、廉价，最重要的是非常美丽的房子，

sentences.en: designed with the American working class in mind.
sentences.zh: 是专为美国工薪阶层设计的。

sentences.en: And it all started with a journalist from Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 这一切都始于一位来自密尔沃基的记者。

sentences.en: In 1934, a Milwaukee Journal reporter named Herbert Jacobs
sentences.zh: 1934年，一位名叫赫伯特·雅各布斯的《密尔沃基日报》记者，

sentences.en: was assigned to take a drive over to Spring Green in central Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 被指派驱车前往威斯康星州中部的斯普林格林。

sentences.en: He was told to write about Taliesin, Frank Lloyd Wright's home and studio.
sentences.zh: 他被告知要写一篇关于塔里埃森的文章，那是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的家和工作室。

sentences.en: Jacobs didn't really know anything about architecture.
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯对建筑一窍不通。

sentences.en: And at that particular time, he wasn't really interested in learning anything about it.
sentences.zh: 而且在当时，他也没什么兴趣去了解这些。

sentences.en: Because Herbert Jacobs had other things on his mind.
sentences.zh: 因为赫伯特·雅各布斯当时满脑子想的都是别的事。

sentences.en: In that November of 1934, his wife was very, very pregnant.
sentences.zh: 1934年11月的那时候，他的妻子正怀着身孕，临产在即。

sentences.en: The night before his reporting trip, he had brought her to the hospital
sentences.zh: 报道行程的前一天晚上，他把妻子送进了医院，

sentences.en: and he stayed up with her until dawn.
sentences.zh: 并彻夜陪伴她直到天亮。

sentences.en: The nurses assured Herbert that he could go on his reporting trip without missing the birth.
sentences.zh: 护士向赫伯特保证，他可以去出差，不会错过孩子的出生。

sentences.en: And so, he set out that morning alone, bleary-eyed, completely unprepared.
sentences.zh: 于是，那天早上他独自出发了，睡眼惺忪，完全没有准备。

sentences.en: He drove 120 miles through the chill, gray Wisconsin countryside for his assignment
sentences.zh: 他驱车120英里，穿过寒冷灰暗的威斯康星乡村，去完成他的任务，

sentences.en: to meet with Frank Lloyd Wright.
sentences.zh: 去见弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特。

sentences.en: couldn't have cared less about his appointment with Herbert Jacobs of the Milwaukee Journal.
sentences.zh: 根本不在乎与《密尔沃基日报》的赫伯特·雅各布斯的预约。

sentences.en: Actually, Wright forgot all about it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，赖特把这事忘得一干二净。

sentences.en: He was known to blow off journalists.
sentences.zh: 他以放记者鸽子而闻名。

sentences.en: When Jacobs arrived at Frank Lloyd Wright's compound,
sentences.zh: 当雅各布斯到达弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的庄园时，

sentences.en: completely distracted by thoughts of his wife and their baby,
sentences.zh: 他满脑子都是妻子和孩子，心不在焉，

sentences.en: he learned that the architect was actually on his way out the door.
sentences.zh: 却得知这位建筑师其实正准备出门。

sentences.en: They got to talk for just over 10 minutes before Wright left abruptly, saying,
sentences.zh: 他们只谈了不到10分钟，赖特就突然离开，说道：

sentences.en: Some of the boys will talk to you now.
The boys were Frank Lloyd Wright's apprentices.
sentences.zh: 这些“小伙子”就是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的学徒们。

sentences.en: They had come to him from all over the world,
sentences.zh: 他们从世界各地慕名而来，

sentences.en: and they were part of a fellowship program that Wright established at his home and studio,
sentences.zh: 是赖特在他家和工作室建立的一个研究员项目的一部分，
他将这个园区称为塔里埃森。

sentences.en: Taliesin, a Welsh word meaning shining brow.
sentences.zh: 塔里埃森是一个威尔士语词汇，意为“闪耀的额头”。

sentences.en: Welsh because it was built on land settled by his family who were farmers from Wales.
sentences.zh: 之所以用威尔士语，是因为它建在他家族定居的土地上，他的家人是来自威尔士的农民。

sentences.en: But the shining brow also has to do with Wright's building philosophy.
sentences.zh: 但“闪耀的额头”也与赖特的建筑哲学有关。

sentences.en: So Taliesin actually is built kind of on the brow,
sentences.zh: 塔里埃森实际上就是建在“额头”上的，

sentences.en: just like your brow of your head.
sentences.zh: 就像你头部的额头一样。

sentences.en: The main Taliesin building curls around the side of a hill, almost like a crown.
sentences.zh: 塔里埃森的主体建筑沿着山坡蜿蜒，就像一顶皇冠。

sentences.en: He felt that you should never build on top of a hill,
sentences.zh: 他认为你不应该在山顶上盖房子，

sentences.en: because that destroyed the integrity of the hill.
sentences.zh: 因为那会破坏山的完整性。
这位是弗洛伊德·汉布林。
他是塔里埃森的一名建筑师。

sentences.en: Also part of the faculty of the Frank Lloyd Wright School of Architecture,
sentences.zh: 也是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特建筑学院的教员之一，

sentences.en: and I've been here since starting as an apprentice back in 1987.
sentences.zh: 我从1987年开始在这里做学徒，就一直待到现在。

sentences.en: Hamblin works and lives at Taliesin full-time,
sentences.zh: 汉布林全职在塔里埃森工作和生活，

sentences.en: here on Frank Lloyd Wright's family land, where Wright used to play as a boy.
sentences.zh: 就在弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特儿时玩耍的这片家族土地上。

sentences.en: So yeah, where are we now?
We are, this is just outside of Spring Green, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我们就在威斯康星州斯普林格林的郊外。

sentences.en: It's a very beautiful green valley with rolling hills.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常美丽的绿色山谷，有着连绵起伏的丘陵。

sentences.en: So he spent a lot of his summers working this land.
sentences.zh: 他夏天大部分时间都在这片土地上劳作。

sentences.en: So he was very familiar with the landscape.
sentences.zh: 所以他对这里的地形非常熟悉。

sentences.en: And this connection with the outdoors was really formative for Wright.
sentences.zh: 这种与户外的联系对赖特来说具有决定性意义。

sentences.en: He thought that architecture should help people live harmoniously with their environment,
sentences.zh: 他认为建筑应该帮助人们与环境和谐共处，

sentences.en: rather than shield them from it.
sentences.zh: 而不是将他们与环境隔绝开来。

sentences.en: The house could become part of nature if it was made with local materials
sentences.zh: 如果房子使用当地材料建造，

sentences.en: and had big windows and was oriented for just the right amount of sunlight.
sentences.zh: 拥有大窗户，并且朝向能获得恰到好处的阳光，它就能成为自然的一部分。

sentences.en: You orient the house just right so that you take advantage of what nature has to offer
sentences.zh: 你要把房子朝向调整得恰到好处，这样就能利用大自然的馈赠，

sentences.en: and you're living with nature rather than trying to fight against it.
sentences.zh: 与自然共生，而不是试图对抗它。

sentences.en: You know, living on the brow of the hill, not on top of it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，住在山坡的“额头”上，而不是山顶上。

sentences.en: This all folded into a concept Frank Lloyd Wright called organic architecture.
sentences.zh: 这一切都融入了弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特所称的“有机建筑”概念中。

sentences.en: He wanted to spread this gospel to the next generation,
sentences.zh: 他想把这个福音传播给下一代，

sentences.en: which is why he returned to the valley he knew as a boy
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他回到儿时熟悉的山谷，
并建立了塔里埃森研究员项目。

sentences.en: The Fellowship was the thing that the Milwaukee Journal wanted Herbert Jacobs to cover in his article.
sentences.zh: 这个项目正是《密尔沃基日报》想让赫伯特·雅各布斯报道的内容。

sentences.en: When Jacobs drove into Taliesin that morning in 1934,
sentences.zh: 当雅各布斯1934年那天早上开车进入塔里埃森时，

sentences.en: the Fellowship had been going on for two years,
sentences.zh: 这个项目已经运行了两年，

sentences.en: and it was hard for the public to wrap their minds around it,
sentences.zh: 公众很难理解它到底是什么，

sentences.en: The Taliesin Fellowship, just what is it?
sentences.zh: 塔里埃森研究员项目，这到底是什么？

sentences.en: A school and yet not a school.
sentences.zh: 一所学校，却又不是学校。

sentences.en: A colony of devoted men and women.
sentences.zh: 一群忠诚的男女组成的团体。

sentences.en: A principality whose king is Frank Lloyd Wright.
sentences.zh: 一个以弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特为王的公国。
他们被称为学徒，而不是学生。

sentences.en: They are, says Mr. Wright, as the fingers of my hand.
sentences.zh: 赖特先生说，他们就像我手上的手指一样。

sentences.en: The apprentices had to pay $1,100 a year to attend the Taliesin Fellowship.
sentences.zh: 学徒们每年必须支付1100美元才能参加塔里埃森研究员项目。
相当于今天的近2万美元。

sentences.en: And it wasn't like an accredited institution or anything.
sentences.zh: 而且它也不是什么认证机构。

sentences.en: Students had to do a lot of grunt work, like baling hay, plowing fields, and making meals.
sentences.zh: 学生们必须做很多苦力活，比如打捆干草、耕地和做饭。

sentences.en: But they got to learn Frank Lloyd Wright's philosophy of architecture,
sentences.zh: 但他们可以学习弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的建筑哲学，

sentences.en: and live with them, and work with them,
even though oftentimes this meant serving as an unpaid labor force.
sentences.zh: 尽管这往往意味着要充当无薪劳动力。

sentences.en: When Jacobs was getting his tour of Taliesin,
sentences.zh: 当雅各布斯参观塔里埃森时，

sentences.en: he described the apprentices as rather long-haired, smiling, and polite young men,
sentences.zh: 他形容学徒们是“留着长发、面带微笑、彬彬有礼的年轻人”，

sentences.en: who tried their best to explain to him what organic architecture means.
sentences.zh: 他们尽力向他解释有机建筑的含义。

sentences.en: Organic architecture is architecture of its time and of its place.
sentences.zh: 有机建筑是属于其时代和地点的建筑。

sentences.en: You're not trying to make it look like something that it's not.
sentences.zh: 你不是在试图让它看起来像它本不是的东西。

sentences.en: Wright thought that there should be no wallpaper to cover things up.
sentences.zh: 赖特认为不应该用壁纸来遮盖东西。
木头就该看起来像木头。
石头就该看起来像石头。
混凝土就该看起来像混凝土。

sentences.en: When Frank Lloyd Wright worked with plywood,
sentences.zh: 当弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特使用胶合板时，

sentences.en: he liked to leave the edge of the plywood exposed so that you saw those layers in there.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢把胶合板的边缘露出来，这样你就能看到里面的层理。

sentences.en: And that became part of the almost ornament or detail.
sentences.zh: 那成了装饰或细节的一部分。

sentences.en: Which was different from frilly, traditional, European-style architecture,
sentences.zh: 这与那种花哨的、传统的、欧洲风格的建筑截然不同，

sentences.en: with rococo gold ornaments and clawfoot chairs and parlors full of knick-knacks.
sentences.zh: 那种建筑有着洛可可式的金色装饰、爪足椅和摆满小摆设的客厅。

sentences.en: Just think of Victorian houses stuffed with lots of tiny rooms
sentences.zh: 试想一下维多利亚时代的房子，塞满了许多小房间，

sentences.en: and covered in bright paint and lacy curtains.
sentences.zh: 覆盖着明亮的油漆和蕾丝窗帘。

sentences.en: This idea of organic architecture wasn't just a break from these traditions.
sentences.zh: 这种有机建筑的理念不仅是对这些传统的决裂。

sentences.en: It was a break from new trends in modern architecture, too.
sentences.zh: 它也是对现代建筑新趋势的决裂。

sentences.en: Cities all over the world were building huge, boxy, glass and steel structures
sentences.zh: 世界各地的城市都在建造巨大的、方方正正的玻璃钢结构建筑，

sentences.en: designed to be hyper-sleek machines for living and working.
sentences.zh: 旨在成为超时尚的居住和工作机器。

sentences.en: Wright explains that these were simply not comfortable for human animals.
sentences.zh: 赖特解释说，这些建筑对人类来说根本不舒适。

sentences.en: Frank Lloyd Wright took the traditional old materials and put them into sleek, modern forMs.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特采用了传统的旧材料，并将它们融入了时尚、现代的形式中。

sentences.en: His organic architecture was a new style, born in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他的有机建筑是一种诞生于美国的新风格。

sentences.en: An organic architecture, a new sense of what constitutes humanity under harmonious conditions.
sentences.zh: 一种有机建筑，一种关于在和谐条件下什么才构成人性的新认识。

sentences.en: A harmonious place in which to live and a harmonious way to live in it.
sentences.zh: 一个和谐的居住场所，以及一种和谐的生活方式。

sentences.en: But Frank Lloyd Wright didn't explain this grand philosophy to the journalist, Herbert Jacobs.
sentences.zh: 但弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特并没有向记者赫伯特·雅各布斯解释这种宏大的哲学。
雅各布斯，因为赖特当时不在那儿。

sentences.en: The apprentices did the best they could, but again, Jacobs was very distracted
sentences.zh: 学徒们尽了最大努力，但雅各布斯当时确实心不在焉，

sentences.en: and was only thinking of his wife in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 满脑子想的都是在医院的妻子。

sentences.en: He thanked the two young men who showed him around Taliesin and got back in his car.
sentences.zh: 他感谢了带他参观塔里埃森的那两位年轻人，然后回到了车里。

sentences.en: Finally, I started back to Milwaukee, learning on the way through a telephone call to the hospital
sentences.zh: “最后，我启程回密尔沃基，在路上通过电话得知，

sentences.en: that I had become a father at about 11 o'clock that morning,
sentences.zh: 那天上午11点左右我当上了父亲，

sentences.en: at the very moment when I was interviewing Wright.
sentences.zh: 正好是我在面试赖特的那一刻。”

sentences.en: Herbert Jacobs, his wife Catherine, and their new daughter
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·雅各布斯、他的妻子凯瑟琳以及他们刚出生的女儿，

sentences.en: lived in Milwaukee for two more years on his reporter's salary of $20 a week.
sentences.zh: 靠着他每周20美元的记者薪水，在密尔沃基又住了两年。

sentences.en: This was in the mid-30s, the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 那是在30年代中期，大萧条时期。

sentences.en: So when Herbert Jacobs was offered a slightly higher-paying job
sentences.zh: 所以，当赫伯特·雅各布斯得到一份薪水略高一点的工作，

sentences.en: with a paper in the state capital of Madison,
sentences.zh: 是在州首府麦迪逊的一家报社时，
他们一家立刻就搬了过去。

sentences.en: When we got to Madison, I couldn't find anything within our price range
sentences.zh: “当我们到了麦迪逊，我找不到任何符合我们预算的房子，

sentences.en: and our newspaper man's price range.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们报社职员的预算范围。

sentences.en: It was what we figured would be nice to live in.
sentences.zh: 那是我们认为住起来会很舒服的价位。”

sentences.en: This is the voice of Herbert Jacobs himself from a 1956 NBC interview.
sentences.zh: 这是赫伯特·雅各布斯本人在1956年接受NBC采访时的录音。

sentences.en: When he and Catherine moved to Madison,
sentences.zh: 当他和凯瑟琳搬到麦迪逊时，

sentences.en: they didn't see any houses they liked or that they could afford.
sentences.zh: 他们没看到任何既喜欢又买得起的房子。

sentences.en: So a cousin of my wife's had been out at Taliesin with Mr. Wright
sentences.zh: “我妻子的一个表亲曾和赖特先生在塔里埃森待过，

sentences.en: and suggested that we have Mr. Wright do something for us.
sentences.zh: 建议我们找赖特先生为我们设计点什么。”

sentences.en: Jacobs didn't really remember much about his first visit to Taliesin two years ago.
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯其实对两年前第一次去塔里埃森的经历记得不太清楚了。

sentences.en: And he murmured something along the lines of,
sentences.zh: 他当时嘟囔了一句类似的话，

sentences.en: very interesting, which his wife's cousin took as a yes.
sentences.zh: 说“很有趣”，他妻子的表亲把它当成了肯定的答复。

sentences.en: But he made an appointment for us to go out there and we went along with that idea.
sentences.zh: “但他还是帮我们预约了去那儿，我们就顺着这个想法去了。”

sentences.en: Then on the way out, my wife and I were trying to think,
sentences.zh: “在去的路上，我和妻子一直在想，

sentences.en: what is it that we can tell this great man, the architect of rich clients,
sentences.zh: 我们能对这位伟人、这位专门为富人服务的建筑师说些什么呢？

sentences.en: what can we say to him that would interest him in our very small case?
sentences.zh: 我们能说些什么才能让他对我们这种微不足道的小案子感兴趣呢？”

sentences.en: In the past, when Frank Lloyd Wright had designed private homes,
sentences.zh: 过去，当弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特设计私人住宅时，

sentences.en: they had not been for people like Herbert and Catherine Jacobs.
sentences.zh: 对象从来都不是像赫伯特和凯瑟琳·雅各布斯这样的人。

sentences.en: Wright had designed gorgeous, wide homes with broad roofs and expansive living rooms
sentences.zh: 赖特设计的是华丽、宽敞、有着大屋顶和开阔客厅的住宅，

sentences.en: They were works of art and they were expensive.
sentences.zh: 它们是艺术品，而且造价昂贵。

sentences.en: So we put it as a sort of challenge.
sentences.zh: “所以我们把它当作一种挑战提了出来。”

sentences.en: What the country needs is a decent $5,000 house.
sentences.zh: “这个国家需要的是一栋体面的5000美元的房子。”
按今天的货币计算，5000美元大约相当于85000美元。

sentences.en: That's a pretty reasonably priced house in most real estate markets.
sentences.zh: 在大多数房地产市场，这算是一栋价格相当合理的房子。

sentences.en: Mr. Wright told us that we were the first clients that ever asked him to build a low-cost house.
sentences.zh: 赖特先生告诉我们，我们是第一批要求他建造低成本住宅的客户。

sentences.en: He said for 20 years he'd been wanting to build one, but no one ever asked him to.
sentences.zh: 他说他20年来一直想盖一栋，但从来没人要求过。

sentences.en: Now Wright had long wanted to make a more democratic form of housing,
sentences.zh: 其实赖特很早以前就想创造一种更民主的住房形式，
甚至在他职业生涯早期就有此想法。

sentences.en: He had been playing around with inexpensive methods of building and other structures,
sentences.zh: 他一直在尝试廉价的建筑方法和其他结构，

sentences.en: and he had a lot of concepts that he had been scheming around urban planning.
sentences.zh: 并且对城市规划有很多构想。

sentences.en: But now, Wright had the chance to make some of his concepts a reality.
sentences.zh: 但现在，赖特有机会将他的一些构想变为现实了。

sentences.en: He had the willing clients, and he had time on his hands.
sentences.zh: 他有愿意配合的客户，而且他有时间。

sentences.en: In 1936, he was in a bit of a slump in his career.
sentences.zh: 1936年，他的职业生涯正处于低谷。

sentences.en: People couldn't afford fancy big new homes.
sentences.zh: 人们买不起豪华的新大房子。

sentences.en: Again, it was the Depression, and a number of big projects had been canceled,
sentences.zh: 再说，当时正值大萧条，许多大型项目都被取消了，

sentences.en: and also Wright had already been practicing for decades,
sentences.zh: 而且赖特已经从业几十年了，

sentences.en: and he was slowly getting written off as a has-been.
sentences.zh: 他正慢慢被人们视为过气人物。

sentences.en: And then in comes this young, open-minded couple.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，这对年轻、思想开明的夫妇出现了。

sentences.en: Wright could tell them his philosophy
sentences.zh: 赖特可以向他们讲述他的哲学，

sentences.en: and teach them how to live well through good architecture.
sentences.zh: 并通过优秀的建筑教导他们如何过上好生活。

sentences.en: Then he said, do you really want a $5,000 house?
sentences.zh: “然后他说，你们真的想要一栋5000美元的房子吗？

sentences.en: He said, most people want a $10,000 house for $5,000.
sentences.zh: 他说，大多数人都想花5000美元买一栋价值10000美元的房子。

sentences.en: Are you willing to give up the things that you have to give up?
sentences.zh: 你们愿意放弃那些必须放弃的东西吗？”

sentences.en: Mr. Wright made a list of the things that the Jacobs would have to do without
sentences.zh: 赖特先生列出了一份清单，列出了雅各布斯夫妇必须舍弃的东西，

sentences.en: if they really wanted a $5,000 house.
sentences.zh: 如果他们真的想要一栋5000美元的房子的话。

sentences.en: Tile bathrooms, extra trim finish and things like that.
sentences.zh: 瓷砖浴室、额外的装饰线条之类的东西。

sentences.en: Are you willing to give those up?
We didn't know anything about it, and we said, sure, it's okay with us.
sentences.zh: “我们对此一无所知，我们说，当然，我们没问题。”

sentences.en: Herbert and Catherine Jacobs didn't know it at the time,
sentences.zh: 赫伯特和凯瑟琳·雅各布斯当时并不知道，

sentences.en: but that modest little house that Frank Lloyd Wright was to build for them
sentences.zh: 但弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特为他们建造的那栋朴素的小房子，

sentences.en: would be the most practical expression of his ideology.
sentences.zh: 将成为他意识形态最实际的体现。

sentences.en: The Jacobs would own the first house in a movement that Wright called Usonia.
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯夫妇将拥有赖特称之为“尤索尼亚”（Usonia）运动中的第一栋房子。

sentences.en: The house that Herbert Jacobs built was the first of the Usonian houses.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·雅各布斯建造的房子是尤索尼亚住宅中的第一栋。

sentences.en: Usonian, a right word meaning the United States as it ought to be at its democratic zenith.
sentences.zh: “尤索尼亚”是一个恰当的词，意指美国应有的民主巅峰状态。

sentences.en: Usonia was Frank Lloyd Wright's name for the United States of North America.
sentences.zh: 尤索尼亚是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特对北美合众国的称呼。

sentences.en: In Wright's vision, Usonia would be a country full of modest, well-made, beautiful,
sentences.zh: 在赖特的愿景中，尤索尼亚将是一个充满朴素、制作精良、美观、

sentences.en: comfortable little houses that the working class could afford.
sentences.zh: 舒适的小房子的国家，工薪阶层也买得起。

sentences.en: These Usonian homes would inspire, educate, and Wright believed create a new culture for all Americans.
sentences.zh: 这些尤索尼亚住宅将激励、教育人们，赖特相信，还能为所有美国人创造一种新文化。

sentences.en: I believe now people are going to know what constitutes good architecture,
sentences.zh: “我相信现在人们会知道什么是好的建筑，

sentences.en: and of course good living has to go with it.
sentences.zh: 当然，好的生活必须与之相伴。

sentences.en: Because you wouldn't dress in a loud and vulgar way in a quiet and beautiful room.
sentences.zh: 因为你不会在安静优美的房间里穿得大吵大闹、庸俗不堪。

sentences.en: All these good things are dependent more or less one on the other
sentences.zh: 所有这些美好的事物或多或少地相互依存，

sentences.en: and add up to something that we call culture.
sentences.zh: 加在一起就是我们所说的文化。

sentences.en: It's only by a natural growth that you can attain culture.
sentences.zh: 只有通过自然的成长，你才能获得文化。”

sentences.en: Wright believed the way to build a better American culture was not en masse,
sentences.zh: 赖特认为，建立更好的美国文化的方式不是大规模地进行，

sentences.en: not in apartment buildings or cookie-cutter developments.
sentences.zh: 不是通过公寓楼或千篇一律的开发项目。

sentences.en: It was to be catered to the individual.
Culture is not for the quell.
Which, to Frank Lloyd Wright, meant that the masses should be unmasked.
sentences.zh: 这对弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特来说，意味着大众应该被“去大众化”。

sentences.en: They should spread out, away from the city.
sentences.zh: 他们应该分散开来，远离城市。

sentences.en: Well, the city, of course, is a thing of the paSt.
sentences.zh: “嗯，城市当然已经是过去式了。

sentences.en: There was a time during the Middle Ages when it was the only source of culture.
sentences.zh: 在中世纪，曾有一段时间它是文化的唯一来源。

sentences.en: There was no way of acquiring this thing we call culture except by direct contact, you see.
sentences.zh: 除了直接接触，没有其他方式可以获得我们所说的文化，你明白吗？”

sentences.en: But for Wright, that wasn't true anymore.
sentences.zh: 但对赖特来说，情况不再是这样了。

sentences.en: People were connected to culture through radio and telephones and automobiles.
sentences.zh: 人们通过广播、电话和汽车与文化相连。

sentences.en: They have transportation, speed, listening, this, which we're using now.
sentences.zh: “他们有交通、速度、聆听，这些我们现在正在使用的东西。

sentences.en: It's no longer essential for people to crowd together anywhere.
sentences.zh: 人们不再需要挤在任何地方了。”

sentences.en: That was Frank Lloyd Wright's vision for America.
sentences.zh: 这就是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特对美国的愿景。

sentences.en: And it would start to become reality in 1936 with the Jacobs House, which he called Usonia 1.
sentences.zh: 它在1936年随着雅各布斯住宅开始成为现实，他称之为“尤索尼亚1号”。

sentences.en: Jacobs House was one of the first ones built.
sentences.zh: 雅各布斯住宅是建造的第一批住宅之一。

sentences.en: This was just a wide-open farmland when it was built out here.
sentences.zh: 这里在建造时还是一片广阔的农田。

sentences.en: This is Bill Martinelli, manager of Usonia 1.
sentences.zh: 这是比尔·马蒂内利，尤索尼亚1号的经理。

sentences.en: It's in a suburban street outside of Madison, now lined with little suburban houses.
sentences.zh: 它位于麦迪逊郊外的一条街道上，现在两旁都是小型的郊区住宅。

sentences.en: But Usonia 1 really stands out, even if you don't know what it is and you're just driving by.
sentences.zh: 但尤索尼亚1号确实很显眼，即使你不知道它是什么，只是开车经过。

sentences.en: Because, from the street, it almost just looks like a beautiful wooden wall.
sentences.zh: 因为从街上看，它几乎看起来就像一堵美丽的木墙。

sentences.en: The house turns its back on the road.
Well, when we get inside or if we go around back, you'll see the whole back of the house is all glass.
sentences.zh: “嗯，当我们进去或者走到后面时，你会看到房子的整个背面全是玻璃。

sentences.en: It's all open to the back.
And he, you know, he did that intentionally to kind of close it off to the street and then open it up to the back.
sentences.zh: 他这样做是有意为之，为了在街道一侧封闭起来，然后向后方打开。”

sentences.en: As Wright saw it, the point of the house was not to have a big facade to show off to your neighbors,
sentences.zh: 在赖特看来，房子的重点不是要有一个大门面来向邻居炫耀，

sentences.en: with a useless and wasteful patch of lawn in the front and a grand entryway.
sentences.zh: 前面留着一块无用且浪费的草坪和一个宏伟的入口。

sentences.en: The house should be built for residents, not onlookers.
sentences.zh: 房子应该是为居住者建造的，而不是为旁观者。

sentences.en: Also, from the street, you can see that there's no garage.
sentences.zh: 此外，从街上可以看到没有车库。

sentences.en: A car is parked under a wooden awning, just a little flat roof with no sidewalls.
sentences.zh: 车停在一个木制遮阳棚下，只是一个没有侧墙的小平顶。

sentences.en: This is the carport, a term that Frank Lloyd Wright coined.
sentences.zh: 这就是“车棚”（carport），是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特创造的术语。

sentences.en: Well, this is the carport of the house.
This is considered the first named carport.
sentences.zh: 这被认为是第一个被命名的车棚。

sentences.en: That was a term that Wright came up with.
sentences.zh: 那是赖特想出的一个词。”

sentences.en: This was one of the many tiny ways Wright kept costs down.
sentences.zh: 这是赖特用来降低成本的众多微小方法之一。

sentences.en: And also, the carport was an education in lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 而且，车棚也是一种生活方式的教育。

sentences.en: Without a garage, the Jacobs wouldn't have space to store their junk.
sentences.zh: 没有车库，雅各布斯夫妇就没有空间存放他们的杂物。

sentences.en: They'd have to simply minimize their possessions and toss what they didn't need.
sentences.zh: 他们必须精简自己的财产，扔掉不需要的东西。

sentences.en: But the carport isn't purely utilitarian.
sentences.zh: 但车棚并不完全是功利性的。

sentences.en: The woodwork on the carport roof has this lovely geometric pattern.
sentences.zh: 车棚屋顶的木制品有一种可爱的几何图案。

sentences.en: And there's like these wood kind of stripes in the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 天花板上还有这种木条纹。

sentences.en: It's funny, when I'd heard about the carport and like seen pictures of it,
sentences.zh: “很有趣，当我听说车棚并看过它的照片时，

sentences.en: I didn't expect it to be so beautiful and like, it's really nice.
sentences.zh: 我没想到它会这么漂亮，它真的很棒。”

sentences.en: In this house, the more you look around, the more you see, you know, like with the ceiling here,
sentences.zh: 在这栋房子里，你看得越多，发现的就越多，比如这个天花板，

sentences.en: the carport, you wouldn't expect that.
sentences.zh: 还有车棚，你不会想到会是这样。

sentences.en: And when you get inside, you'll see the same thing.
sentences.zh: 当你进去后，你会看到同样的情况。”

sentences.en: Usonia 1 is full of small, elegant details.
sentences.zh: 尤索尼亚1号充满了精致的小细节。

sentences.en: Can you see how the sun comes in?
sentences.zh: 你能看到阳光是怎么照进来的吗？

sentences.en: Every, like the brick and the wood and the...
sentences.zh: 每一处，比如砖块和木头，还有……

sentences.en: Your eye kind of gets drawn in.
sentences.zh: 你的视线会被吸引进去。

sentences.en: And inside, it's pretty much one room and a loud cat.
sentences.zh: 里面基本上是一个大房间，还有一只吵闹的猫。

sentences.en: No walls between, you know, living room, dining room, kitchen.
sentences.zh: 客厅、餐厅、厨房之间没有墙壁。

sentences.en: That was kind of innovative for the time.
sentences.zh: 这在当时算是相当创新的。

sentences.en: The kitchen is an alcove adjacent to the living slash dining space with no door.
sentences.zh: 厨房是客厅兼餐厅空间旁边的一个凹室，没有门。

sentences.en: And it's a very, very tiny area.
sentences.zh: 而且是一个非常、非常小的区域。

sentences.en: It's just a little bit wider than the length of my arms, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想它只比我双臂展开的长度宽一点点。

sentences.en: There's a small hallway with tiny bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 那里有一条带小卧室的小走廊。

sentences.en: But mostly the one main room is the focus.
sentences.zh: 但主要的焦点还是那个大房间。

sentences.en: It's where you're supposed to eat, relax, read, live, all together.
sentences.zh: 那是你吃饭、放松、阅读、生活，所有活动都在一起的地方。
再说回赫伯特·雅各布斯。

sentences.en: Mr. Wright is an advocate of the open plan on housing.
sentences.zh: 赖特先生是住房开放式布局的倡导者。

sentences.en: That is, the removal of the boxes within boxes sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，拆除那种“盒中套盒”式的结构。

sentences.en: So that you don't have many partitions.
sentences.zh: 这样你就不会有太多的隔断。

sentences.en: The temptation is to be together much more.
sentences.zh: 人们会更倾向于待在一起。

sentences.en: The open plan was pretty novel.
sentences.zh: 开放式布局在当时相当新颖。

sentences.en: And it was cost-saving to not have many walls.
sentences.zh: 而且减少墙壁也能节省成本。

sentences.en: The Usonian house is full of these clever, less expensive solutions.
sentences.zh: 尤索尼安住宅充满了这类巧妙且低成本的解决方案。

sentences.en: Like the lights on the ceiling.
So that's just a steel channel with the wires just laying in there.
sentences.zh: 那只是一个钢槽，电线就直接铺在里面。

sentences.en: And then bare sockets, bare bulbs.
sentences.zh: 然后是裸露的灯座和灯泡。

sentences.en: So that's considered the first track lighting.
sentences.zh: 所以那被认为是第一代轨道照明。
这也是该住宅的又一个“第一”。

sentences.en: And now you see track lighting everywhere.
sentences.zh: 现在你随处可见轨道照明。

sentences.en: Wherever you see lights or bulbs affixed to a single beam.
sentences.zh: 无论你在哪里看到固定在单根横梁上的灯具或灯泡。
那都是尤索尼安的发明。

sentences.en: Other innovations Usonia popularized include the use of flat roofs,
sentences.zh: 尤索尼安推广的其他创新还包括平屋顶的使用、

sentences.en: Herbert Jacobs loved those heated floors.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·雅各布斯非常喜欢那些地暖。
地暖，现在已经很普遍了。

sentences.en: But at that time, there were no floor-heated residences in this country.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，这个国家还没有地暖住宅。

sentences.en: All of these innovations were meant to help the family live well and frugally.
sentences.zh: 所有这些创新都是为了帮助家庭生活得既舒适又节俭。

sentences.en: They saved money while they lived in the house.
sentences.zh: 他们住在这所房子里省下了钱。

sentences.en: And they had also saved costs in the construction of the house.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在建造房子时也节省了成本。

sentences.en: But Wright used some other cost-saving measures that were kind of cheating.
sentences.zh: 但赖特还用了一些其他省钱手段，有点像是在“作弊”。

sentences.en: Like he stole some bricks from another building of his that he was constructing nearby.
sentences.zh: 比如他从自己附近正在施工的另一栋建筑里偷了一些砖块。

sentences.en: Well, Wright didn't steal the bricks himself.
sentences.zh: 好吧，赖特本人并没有去偷砖。

sentences.en: He sent a bunch of his apprentices over to Racine, Wisconsin,
sentences.zh: 他派了一群学徒去威斯康星州的拉辛，

sentences.en: where his design for the Johnson Wax Building was under construction.
sentences.zh: 那里正在建造他设计的庄臣公司总部大楼。

sentences.en: He told the apprentices to grab as many bricks as they could and bring them back to Madison.
sentences.zh: 他告诉学徒们尽可能多拿些砖块，然后带回麦迪逊。

sentences.en: If you're familiar with the Johnson Wax Building, the corners are curved.
sentences.zh: 如果你熟悉庄臣公司总部大楼，就会知道它的拐角是圆弧形的。

sentences.en: So you can see some of these bricks are convex and some are concave.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到有些砖块是凸面的，有些是凹面的。

sentences.en: Well, those would have been like corner bricks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些本来应该是拐角用的砖。

sentences.en: Another way Wright kept costs down was by taking a huge pay cut himself.
sentences.zh: 赖特控制成本的另一种方式是他自己大幅降低了设计费。

sentences.en: The bill I paid was for $5,500, which included Mr. Wright's fee of $450.
sentences.zh: 我支付的账单是5500美元，其中包括赖特先生450美元的费用。

sentences.en: By hook or by crook, Wright did it.
sentences.zh: 不管用什么手段，赖特做到了。

sentences.en: He met his challenge of building a beautiful house that Herbert and Catherine could afford.
sentences.zh: 他完成了挑战，建造了一栋赫伯特和凯瑟琳负担得起的美丽住宅。

sentences.en: It was a total adjustment for the family.

sentences.en: And so after six years of living in Usonia 1, the Jacobs family would move off to the countryside,

sentences.en: But Herbert Jacobs thought of their first home very fondly.

sentences.en: But it was a group of his apprentices that would carry on his vision by building an entire community of Usonian houses.
